turnaround_reason: Forward Air is a broken-deal distressed situation: its ~$2.1B January 2024 Omni Logistics acquisition loaded ~$1.4B of debt onto the balance sheet, net debt is ~5.5x EBITDA, a formal sale review ended with no buyer, and the company is now selling non-core assets to deleverage.
bullish_points: Deleveraging optionality: asset sales underway (an Omni unit closed July 2026 for ~$16.5M with an expected gain; Intermodal and other Omni units for sale)
Q2 described as a 'step in the right direction' operationally despite the headline loss
Equity is a highly-levered call option on successful debt reduction if freight demand cooperates
Revenue growing modestly (+8.8% YoY) off the combined base
bearish_points: Net debt ~$1.68B at ~5.5x EBITDA — balance sheet is the whole story and it is stretched
The strategic review ended WITHOUT a buyer, removing the cleanest exit and signaling weak strategic interest
A contract-logistics customer representing ~10% of $2.5B revenue intends to diversify away — direct revenue risk
$244M goodwill impairment and a $207M Q2 net loss; negative net margin (-11%)
Freight cycle is soft; deleveraging via asset sales into a weak market fetches low prices
catalyst: Completion of Omni/Intermodal asset sales that materially cut leverage and clarify the go-forward entity
catalyst_timing: Rolling through 2H 2026 as the strategic review concludes
suggested_trade: Pass, or a tiny speculative spot only for those who want the levered deleveraging option
key_risk: Debt load plus the 10% customer defection overwhelms slow asset-sale progress, forcing a distressed outcome
would_skip_if: Leverage stays above ~5x, the large customer confirms its exit, or freight demand weakens further
